$comment: Client logo strip at the foot of the hero. Rules: DESIGN_SYSTEM.md, section 10. Put each genuine logo in site/assets/clients/ as <file>.svg (preferred) or <file>.png: a clean black variant on a transparent background, never redrawn, retyped, stretched or cropped. Then run python3 scripts/build.py, which writes the strip into site/index.html in this order and names any brand still missing. scale evens out optical prominence (1 = the standard row height). Speeds are CSS pixels per second, left to right; narrow applies under 640 px. Record every source in SOURCES.md.
